deck.p3: Most growers keep notes in a notebook, photos in the camera roll, and the rest in their head. Then something goes wrong in week nine and nobody can reconstruct what actually happened.

deck.p11: Watering and feeding due, before it slips.
deck.p13: Reads your logs, says what’s next. Asks before acting.
deck.p14: $0 · no wallet · your journal is yours. growtoo is a documentation tool, not legal advice — always follow the rules where you grow.
deck.p15: Open the plant, tap what you did, done. The reminder clears itself and the coach picks up from there.
deck.h24: Proof, only if you want it.
deck.p20: Most growers never touch this part, and the journal works fine without it. But if you want a record other people can check — a buyer, a partner, or just your future self — each completed stage can be sealed on Solana with a transaction anyone can open.
deck.p21: Normal journal work. Nothing extra to learn.
deck.p22: Optional mint tied to that journal entry. Wallet needed only here.
deck.p23: Anyone can open the transaction and check the trail themselves.
deck.p24: Sealed on-chain when you choose, never because you must.
deck.p25: Today this runs on Solana’s public test network (Devnet). The transactions are real; the tokens are test assets with no monetary value.
deck.h25: The first growers shape what ships.
deck.p26: We’re building this with growers, not for an imagined one. Journal now, tell us what’s missing, and it goes into the next release.
